accepted.why: Known defect, deliberately not fixed here: TRANSFORMS.number and .boolean in parts/nodes.js are unguarded, so one unparseable value aborts the whole expression and discards every correctly-mapped field. uppercase/lowercase/trim already defend with $string() (nodes.js:80-83); number and boolean do not. Hardening them changes the emitted output for every existing mapping, so it is a separate decision -- and this suite is what will prove it.
